message: Add initial support for Microsoft Teams marketplace integration to allow users to manage emails directly from Teams. This PR introduces a new `TeamsInstallation` database model and related API endpoints and UI components. All changes are additive, feature-flagged (`NEXT_PUBLIC_TEAMS_ENABLED`), and isolated, ensuring no breaking changes to existing application functionality or database schema. ---
